vendor: Popgun Labs Pty Ltd (trading as Splash / Splash Music)
product_family: Consumer AI music-creation and social-gaming products: the Splash Music mobile app (AI beat maker), the Splash on Roblox experience (in-game social music/skate world), and Kaimix / WEMIX ('wemixed') — an AI voice-to-music tool where a user hums, sings, or talks and the product builds a track around it, which supports collaborative 'remixing' of others' tracks.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1/2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. No trust center, security page, or SOC 2 mention found on splashmusic.com or kaimix.com; the site has no dedicated security/compliance page at all.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Privacy policy mentions only generic 'SSL certificates and other database security mechanisms', no formal ISO certification referenced.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of an AI-governance certification anywhere on the vendor's site.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable / no evidence. Splash is a consumer music/gaming product that does not process health data; privacy policy lists gameplay, contact, and device data only, with no HIPAA reference.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Kaimix privacy policy mentions collecting 'financial information including credit card information' but does not state PCI DSS compliance or name a certified payment processor.

certifications.name: GDPR (formal posture statement)
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy is written under the Australian Privacy Act 1988 and 'Australian Privacy Law'; no GDPR articles, EU representative, or lawful-basis language appear anywhere in the document, despite the app being distributed globally via the App Store, Google Play, and Roblox.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence; not applicable to this consumer product category.

privacy.ai_training_note: No explicit statement was found on whether user-submitted voice/audio (the core input to the Kaimix/WEMIX AI music feature) is used to train models. The company's own AI music tool (kaimix.com / wemixed.com) currently 302-redirects to https://splashmusic.com/maintenance/, indicating that product surface is offline or under maintenance at time of review, which also means its live privacy/terms text could not be directly inspected. This is an unresolved gap, not a confirmed 'no training' posture.
privacy.data_region: Not specified. Privacy policy states personal information may be disclosed 'outside of Australia to cloud providers' including Microsoft PlayFab, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, and Mailchimp, but does not commit to a specific data-residency region.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Vendor states use of 'SSL certificates and other database security mechanisms'; no further detail (e.g., TLS version, at-rest encryption specifics) is published.

security.name: Formal security/compliance program
security.value: Not verified. No trust center, security whitepaper, or subprocessor list is published.

security.name: Children's privacy / COPPA posture
security.value: Not addressed in the privacy policy despite the flagship product being a Roblox experience, a platform with a large population of minor users.

products.name: Splash on Roblox
products.data_scope: Roblox account linkage, gameplay data, chat logs, device/geolocation data (per Roblox platform + Splash privacy policy)
products.notes: Governed by both Splash's own Terms/Privacy Policy and Roblox's platform-level Terms of Use and Privacy Policy; Roblox terms are separate from and not controlled by Popgun Labs.

products.name: Splash Music app (iOS/Android)
products.category: Consumer AI beat-maker / music creation app
products.data_scope: Account, device ID, monetization info per app store listing; distributed via Apple App Store and Google Play
products.notes: Listed on app stores under 'Splash Music: Beat Maker'; no separate security documentation found beyond the general splashmusic.com privacy policy.

products.name: Kaimix / WEMIX ('wemixed')
products.category: AI voice-to-music generation and collaborative remixing
products.data_scope: User-submitted voice/audio (humming, singing, talking) used to generate a music track; also names, age, gender, postcode, contact and financial/credit-card info per Kaimix privacy policy
products.notes: Core AI-generation product. As of this review, kaimix.com and wemixed.com redirect to a maintenance page on splashmusic.com, so current availability and live terms could not be confirmed.

compare.pricing_model: Not verified from available pages (no pricing page captured; consumer app store listings likely free/freemium, unconfirmed)
compare.data_residency: Not specified; Australian company using AWS/GCP/Microsoft PlayFab, no committed region

flags: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, or GDPR-specific compliance evidence found anywhere on the vendor's own domain; this is consistent with a small consumer app studio, not an enterprise-grade posture.

Privacy policy is scoped to Australian Privacy Law only and does not mention GDPR, despite global app-store and Roblox distribution that plausibly reaches EU users — potential compliance gap, not confirmed non-compliance.
No explicit statement on whether user voice/audio submitted to the Kaimix/WEMIX AI feature is used for AI model training; trains_on_customer_data recorded as null (unresolved), not false.

The Kaimix/WEMIX AI music product (kaimix.com, wemixed.com) currently redirects to a maintenance page, while the splashmusic.com homepage still actively promotes 'TRY WEMIXED' — a live discrepancy between marketing and current product availability that AIFOXX listing copy should account for.

Splash's flagship distribution channel is a Roblox game; the privacy policy does not address children's privacy/COPPA despite Roblox's large minor user base — worth a caveat given AIFOXX may be indexed by parents/guardians or education-adjacent buyers.
